Definition: the blast of a horn (from its continuous sound); specifically, the signal of the silver trumpets; hence, the instrument itself and the festival thus introduced
BiblicalUsage: 1) ram, ram's horn, trumpet, cornet; 1a) ram (only in combination); 1a1) ram's horn, trumpet; 1b) jubilee year (marked by the blowing of cornets) (meton)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
